variants.q: What happened when patrols caught enslaved people off the plantation without a pass?

results.name: Green Cumby
results.snip: Den you didn't have to bother with no pass to leave de plantation, and de patter rolls didn't bother you.

results.name: Fred Brown
results.snip: One time my pappy and my mammy goes out without de pass and de patters takes after dem.

variants.label: Patrols

variants.q: What did the patterrollers do when they cotched folks without a pass?

results.name: Green Cumby
results.snip: Den you didn't have to bother with no pass to leave de plantation, and de patter rolls didn't bother you.

results.name: Fred Brown
results.snip: De patters hits him five or six licks and lets him go.

results.name: Fred Brown
results.snip: One time my pappy and my mammy goes out without de pass and de patters takes after dem.

variants.q: Horses frightened and running away with a carriage

results.name: Albert Hill
results.snip: But de worst trouble I ever has is with one hoss.

results.name: Carey Davenport
results.snip: I say, 'Missus, she whip me 'cause young marse John git whip that time and not me.' He make me git down and git up on his horse behin' him and ride up to the big house.

results.name: Green Cumby
results.snip: "To see de runaway slaves in de woods scared me to death.

variants.label: Runaway carriage

variants.q: De hosses skeert and run off with de coach

results.name: Lewis Jones
results.snip: "I has de bad luck jus' one time with dat team and it am disaway: massa have jus' change de power for de gin from hoss to steam and dey am ginnin' cotton and I's with dat team 'side de house and de hosses am a-prancin' and waitin' for missy to come out.

results.name: Lewis Jones
results.snip: "Massa have de fine coach and de seat for de driver am up high in front and I's de coachman and he dresses me nice and de hosses am fine, white team.

results.name: James Brown
results.snip: I'se stays on wid him for many years and works as coachman.
